curves.name: MM1Z3V3 zener characteristic
curves.test_conditions: T_a = 25 degC, pulsed, P_D = 500 mW; curve labeled 3V3 in the multi-device plot; dashed test-current reference I_Z = 5 mA. Reverse-bias zener current and voltage are plotted as positive magnitudes.

datasheet_identity.title: MM1Z2V0 THRU MM1Z75 SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: The supplied public PDF has SHA-256 ff4a1051509db45f49817a41e5674adc11a1dea2a91e51ee958ffaed19b1d755.

Electrical characteristics are specified at T_a = 25 degC unless otherwise noted. The target row is MM1Z3V3: V_Z minimum 3.1 V, nominal 3.3 V, maximum 3.5 V at I_ZT = 5 mA; the nominal V_Z and paired I_ZT are used for the breakdown inputs.

The datasheet states that the cathode line denotes the cathode end. Zener quantities are reverse-bias quantities, with cathode positive relative to anode; the plotted I_Z and V_Z are positive magnitudes.
The MM1Z3V3 row publishes Z_ZT = 130 ohm maximum at I_ZT = 5 mA. No I_ZK or Z_ZK value is published, so knee sharpness cannot be independently extracted into this schema.
The only forward-voltage datum is V_F = 0.9 V at I_F = 10 mA in the Maximum Ratings table and is treated as a maximum. No forward IV figure is provided.
No junction-capacitance or reverse-recovery specification is published, so capacitance and reverse recovery are omitted.

Fig. 1 contains a labeled 3V3 zener characteristic under the stated pulsed conditions. Curve points are digitized from the actual plotted line only and are not interpolated from the electrical-characteristics table.
The datasheet contains no temperature sweep; all extracted electrical values are at 25 degC.
